blind.B1: No for an exercise question. The paper compares hindlimb unloading (disuse, 3 weeks) with aging in C57BL/6J mice (ABS.p2, S2.1.p1); no exercise, training or loading arm. Exercise only as background. GEO has no exercise words in any column. No sample carries an exercise factor.
blind.B2: 6mo HLU vs 6mo control, 22mo vs 6mo control, and 4mo HLU vs control (4mo from a prior study, not in this series) (S3.3.p1-p2). Methods n: 6mo male control 8, 6mo male HLU 8, 22mo male control 11 (S2.1.p1). GEO: 6mo male control 5, 6mo male HLU 5, 22mo male control 10, plus 3 male 22mo HLU and 7 female controls not described in the paper.
blind.B3: Not stated in the paper. Each animal gives one tibia, so no repeated measure is expected. The packet's pairing key (title minus age level) only matches 'control 1/2/3' numbering across ages, so it is not an animal ID; the expression check says not_supported (diff 0.169, perm p 0.043, status not_supported).
blind.B4: S2.4.p1 says only 'Differential gene expression was powered using limma' on BioJupies; it does not say joint or pairwise. Each comparison (Fig 5G-I) looks like a pairwise BioJupies run.
blind.B5: S3.3.p2: 'The threshold for significance was a logFC > |1.5| and a p-value < 0.05' (raw p, no FDR). No DEG counts in the text; volcano plots only (Fig 5G-I).

checks.evidence: ABS.p2, S2.1.p1; packet A shows no exercise words in any column.
No contrast was run. The GEO sample set differs from the paper's (7 female controls, 3 male 22mo HLU, n 5/5/10 vs 8/8/11); this is recorded as a discrepancy.
Flagged key is a label-numbering artefact; pairing_check status not_supported; one tibia per mouse; no repeated measure in the paper.
No model fitted. The paper is silent on joint vs pairwise (S2.4.p1).
No analysis run. Sex and age are partly aliased with HLU in GEO (all HLU are male; 22mo HLU only 3), which would matter only if the series were analyzed for the disuse question.
Integer counts, median 11; BioJupies kallisto estimated counts rounded; case stops at design, paper used limma on logCPM.
paper_threshold records raw p<0.05 and logFC>|1.5| from S3.3.p2, matching B5.
No ours-vs-paper numbers; HANDBACK claims none (0/0 contrasts).
'No exercise arm' holds: the whole design (control/HLU, 6/22 mo) and all text columns were checked, and the paper has no exercise arm. The wide search (metadata and paper) supports the claim.

summary: 该系列是后肢悬吊(失用)与衰老的比较,论文和GEO元数据均无运动组,因此在design阶段拒绝运行是正确的,停止理由成立。配对键候选只是标题编号造成的假象,表达检验不支持,无重复测量问题。论文阈值(原始p<0.05且logFC>|1.5|)记录准确;GEO与论文样本集的差异已记录。
